images.filename: Historic Borra Caves main entrance in Araku Valley.jpg
images.caption: Main entrance of the historic Borra Caves, located on the East Coast of India, in the Ananthagiri hills of the Araku Valley, Andhra Pradesh. The photo was taken in 2013.
images.alt: Main entrance of the historic Borra Caves, located on the East Coast of India, in the Ananthagiri hills of the Araku Valley, Andhra Pradesh. The photo was taken in 2013.

images.caption:
Borra caves are believed to be 150-million-year-old with Stalagmite formations.
These caves are in the Visakhapatnam District of Andhra Pradesh, India.
These formations are of different shapes, resembling, Mother child, crocodile, Sage’s beard, Goddess Parvathi, tiger and others.

The formation of brain shaped stalagmite at the center of cave is the main attraction.
